study_strategy.warning: Current Kew accepts Prunus serotina var. eximia. The learner keeps one species-level P. serotina canonical entry and teaches var. eximia internally to avoid duplicate black-cherry concepts.

quick_split: P. mexicana — canonical PASS; small deciduous tree, showy early white flowers on short spur shoots, larger plum fruit.
P. rivularis — distinct creek plum; low thicket-forming shrub, small flower clusters along branches, yellow-to-red plums; B131 PASS candidate pending independent review.
P. serotina — canonical PASS; deciduous tree, long white racemes, black drupes, dark scaly bark; local var. eximia taught internally.
P. caroliniana — evergreen glossy leaves and short axillary racemes; range HOLD.
P. angustifolia — thicket-forming Chickasaw plum with narrow serrate leaves and red/yellow drupes; range HOLD.
